question: Which of the following carries blood from the heart to the kidneys?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Renal artery**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Renal artery** is responsible for carrying blood from the heart to the kidneys.
 
• The renal arteries branch off from the abdominal aorta and supply the kidneys with blood.
 
• Each kidney receives blood through its own renal artery, ensuring a sufficient supply of oxygenated blood for filtration and other kidney functions.
 
• The renal arteries play a crucial role in maintaining kidney health and overall bodily function by providing the necessary nutrients and oxygen.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **Vena cava** is a large vein that carries deoxygenated blood from the body back to the heart.
 
• The **Renal vein** carries filtered blood away from the kidneys back to the heart.
 
• The **Coronary artery** supplies blood to the heart muscles.
 
• The kidneys filter about 120 to 150 quarts of blood daily, producing 1 to 2 quarts of urine.
 
• Proper function of the renal arteries is essential for effective kidney filtration and overall homeostasis.
